components.text: The sister sigil to the Water Sigil. Right-click when holding the Lava Sigil to create a source block of $(fire)lava$() on the ground, for the cost of $(blood)1000 LP$(). Crafted via the Alchemy Table and an Alchemy Array; it'll drain 5 hearts from you if you don't have enough LP in your Soul Network.
It can also be used in the Alchemy Table to automate the production of $(fire)Lava Buckets$(). The Sigil is not consumed in this recipe.
